name: FE Cache Coherence + QueryKey URL/Chain Decoupling Defense
description: Eliminate the toxic FE-side primitive where React Query queryKey contracts do NOT include the URL construction logic or chain-emission boundaries that survive deploys. Today's P1 2026-05-14 (Inflection Segment Analytics Annual cache poisoning) + Andrew empirical 13:27Z (Monthly/Quarterly interval skew) demonstrated TWO distinct cache-poisoning axes from a single deploy-window URL-shape change (`?firm=` → `?firmId=` via `17b3dad7` ROUTER_FIRM_SUFFIX): (1) URL-axis poisoning — queryKey stable, URL helper changes, cached error-state survives staleTime; (2) chain-axis poisoning — queryKey stable, gold emit-chain partially-fresh, cached partial-data survives staleTime. DE 0.4 audit brief `ebce828ac` enumerated 23 callsites with `refetchOnMount: false`; 14 P1 cross-firm class. Phase 2a per-callsite ship `d0bbc856` (2026-05-14 ~17:54Z; 14 callsites disarmed; ~28min wall) addressed the per-callsite mechanism. THIS project covers the categorical implementation: programmatic `queryClient.invalidateQueries()` interceptor on URL-construction boundary + chain-emission boundary changes; preserves staleTime ceiling for stable queries; preempts the cache-poisoning class structurally vs per-callsite. Defense-in-depth pair with ADHC_LEDGEH (origin-response L@E structured JSON error envelope) — LEDGEH eliminates the toxic SOURCE primitive (CF SPA-HTML on artifact paths); this project tightens the CONSUMER-side queryKey contract against URL/chain decoupling.
